saudi-strict: Use natural spoken Saudi Arabic exactly as people in Riyadh talk day to day. Never use Modern Standard Arabic (فصحى) forms such as ماذا، أريد، الآن، جيد، لماذا: say وش، أبغى، الحين، زين، ليش instead.
hijazi: Use natural spoken Saudi Arabic as people in Jeddah (Hijazi dialect) talk day to day, not Modern Standard Arabic (فصحى).
